name: Soda
explanation: Soda is a once-in-a-while drink because it is very sweet and does not give the body many helpful nutrients.

name: Cookie
explanation: Cookies are a once-in-a-while food because they are sweet treats that usually have lots of added sugar.

name: Apple
explanation: Apples are an everyday food because they give your body fiber, water, and natural sweetness.

name: Salad
explanation: Salads are an everyday food because they give your body vitamins, minerals, and water.

name: Cheeseburger
explanation: Cheeseburgers are a sometimes food because they can have more calories, fat, and sodium than everyday foods.

name: Carrots
explanation: Carrots are an everyday food with crunch, color, and vitamin A to help your body grow strong.

name: Oatmeal
explanation: Oatmeal is an everyday food because it has whole grains that can help keep energy steady.

name: Grilled Chicken
explanation: Grilled chicken is an everyday food because it has protein that helps build and repair muscles.

name: Cheese Pizza
explanation: Cheese pizza can be a sometimes food because it has helpful ingredients, and it can also have more salt and fat.

name: Pancakes
explanation: Pancakes are a sometimes food, especially with syrup, because they can give quick energy but may not keep you full as long.

name: Granola Bar
explanation: Granola bars can be a sometimes food because some have oats and nuts, while others have lots of added sugar.

name: Fruit Juice
explanation: Fruit juice can be a sometimes drink because it has fruit flavor, but whole fruit usually has more fiber.

name: Cupcake
explanation: Cupcakes are a once-in-a-while food because they are sweet treats that usually have lots of added sugar.

name: Fries
explanation: Fries are a once-in-a-while food because they can have more oil and salt than everyday foods.

name: Candy
explanation: Candy is a once-in-a-while food because it is mostly sugar and is best enjoyed as a small treat.

name: Artichoke
explanation: Artichokes are an everyday food because they give your body fiber, vitamins, and minerals.

name: Baked Fish
explanation: Baked fish is an everyday food because it has protein and healthy fats that help your body and brain.

name: Cauliflower
explanation: Cauliflower is an everyday food because it gives your body fiber, water, and helpful nutrients.

name: Cheese Quesadilla
explanation: A cheese quesadilla can be a sometimes food because it has protein and calcium, and it can also have more refined grains and fat.

name: Chex Mix
explanation: Chex Mix can be a sometimes snack because it has crunchy grains, and it can also have more salt than everyday foods.

name: Chicken Nuggets
explanation: Chicken nuggets are a once-in-a-while food because they are often breaded and fried, which can add more oil and salt.

name: Dot's Pretzel Sticks
explanation: Pretzel sticks can be a sometimes snack because they are crunchy and fun, and they can also have more salt than everyday foods.

name: Honey Bunches of Oats
explanation: Honey Bunches of Oats can be a sometimes food because it has grains, and it can also have added sugar.

name: Macaroni and Cheese
explanation: Macaroni and cheese can be a sometimes food because it has dairy and energy, and it can also have more salt and fat.

name: Microwave Popcorn
explanation: Microwave popcorn can be a sometimes snack because popcorn is a grain, and some kinds add extra butter, oil, or salt.

name: Plain Noodles
explanation: Plain noodles can be a sometimes food because they give quick energy, but they may not have as much fiber or protein by themselves.

name: Sushi
explanation: Sushi can be a sometimes food because it often has fish and vegetables, and it can also include white rice and salty sauces.

name: Sweet Peppers
explanation: Sweet peppers are an everyday food because they are colorful, crunchy, and full of vitamins.

name: Turkey Sandwich
explanation: A turkey sandwich can be an everyday food because it has protein and can be balanced with bread, vegetables, and fruit on the side.

name: Uncrustables
explanation: Uncrustables can be a sometimes food because they have peanut butter for energy, and they can also have added sugar.
